title: Median Salary per Department
scenario: Calculate the median salary for each department. Return 'dept_id' and 'median_salary'.
tableSchema: employees (emp_id INT, dept_id INT, salary INT)
hint: Use PERCENT_RANK() to identify the middle row.
correctQuery: SELECT dept_id, AVG(salary)::NUMERIC AS median_salary FROM (SELECT dept_id, salary, PERCENT_RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY dept_id ORDER BY salary) as pr FROM employees) t WHERE pr BETWEEN 0.45 AND 0.55 GROUP BY dept_id;
setupSQL: CREATE TABLE employees (emp_id INT, dept_id INT, salary INT);
